summary: Completed frontend testing of testimonial carousel fix for 'Voices and Impact' section. User reported cards were too small and text was not readable due to previous square aspect ratio and aggressive scale-down effect. Fix successfully verified: cards now use 4:5 portrait aspect ratio (not square), increased font size (18px desktop), line-clamp-6, and softened 3D scale effect (min 0.8x vs 0.72x). All 4 testimonials display legibly on both desktop (1920px) and mobile (390px) viewports.
passed_tests: Testimonial cards now have 4:5 portrait aspect ratio (0.800) instead of square - verified on desktop and mobile
Card dimensions increased: desktop 444×555px, mobile 315×394px - noticeably larger than before
Quote text clearly readable: 18px font size on desktop, line-height 28px, line-clamp-6 (increased from 5)
All 4 testimonials (Michael W., Carolyn K./CACI, Peter W./NATO, Stefanie M.) display legibly when active
3D perspective effect present but softened: active card scales 1.08x, side cards min 0.8x (was 0.72x), opacity min 0.45 (was 0.35)
Avatar (h-12/14), name, and title/org text clearly visible and not cramped
Carousel navigation working: next/prev arrows and dot navigation functional on desktop and mobile
Mobile viewport (390px) displays cards properly with portrait ratio and readable text
Services and Contact sections unaffected (regression check passed)
